0022600097.text: The Raptors, now 1-0 and 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East, visit the 1-0 Wizards, who sit 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East. In the 2025-26 season series, Toronto won 2-1, including a 134-125 win in Washington on February 28, 2026, and no games have been played between the teams yet this season. Ruled out for Toronto are Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot), while Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip).
